description: 5 should-trigger + 6 should-not-trigger (one an unrelated counterexample) queries. Should-trigger covers writing or rewriting a project README from the repository itself (EN + DE phrasings). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbors: reviewing an existing README (readme-reviewer), a README for a reusable package (readme-writing-package), agent docs (agent-docs-writing), a changelog, and de-slopping finished prose (humanizer).

queries.q: write a README for this repo
our README is outdated, rewrite it from what the project actually does
create a README with setup steps and the commands we really use
schreib die README für dieses Projekt neu
the README is a mess, improve it for new contributors
review our README for broken setup steps
write the README for our npm library so people can install it
update AGENTS.md with the new module layout
draft the changelog entry for this release
this blog post reads like AI wrote it, fix the tone
fix the failing date parser test in the billing module
